description: In Dials, an account whose provider occurs once uses the provider name alone. Among accounts of one provider, use a present, unique masked email as the secondary identity; otherwise use the account's one-based position among all accounts of that provider ordered by creation time, then by ID compared as Unicode scalars (not UTF-16 or locale collation). Accounts shown by email still count toward positions. Reading rank does not affect identity. Expected results are hand-written; no localized strings are compared.
schema: vectors: array of { name: string; accounts: array of { id: string; provider: string; createdAt: epoch milliseconds; maskedEmail: string or null }; ranks: array of nonempty arrays of ids, each listing all accounts in presentation order; expected: array of { id: string; kind: providerOnly | email | number; email: string or null; number: integer or null } }. Every key is present. Every account occurs exactly once in each rank list and in expected. The same expected identities apply to every rank list. Masked emails are already masked; null means absent.

vectors.name: one account per provider does not show a secondary identity
two different masked emails identify the two accounts
identical masked emails use account numbers
two missing emails also use account numbers
numbered accounts count email-labelled siblings but not other providers
a rank swap leaves account numbers attached to the same ids
equal creation times compare Unicode scalars rather than UTF-16 code units
